question: What purifying power is attributed to the hymn of the great goddess Pītāmbarī?
premises: The hymn belongs to Pītāmbarī, the great goddess.
The hymn is described as destroying sin.
inference: The hymn of the great goddess Pītāmbarī has the power to destroy sin.
plain_english: This is the hymn of the great goddess Pītāmbarī, which destroys sin.
